name: Fuffi
source:
Companion of Xio's.

A cute and energetic plush android, trying to support Xio as best she can. Is hiding a lot about herself. Mascot of the team.

Sign: Thinks of herself as a Libra.
Favourite Food: AC or DC is fine.
Hobbies: Being cute. It's hard work you know!
Likes: Xio.
Dislikes: Speaking honestly.
